limitations: AAC loudness and packet hashes are measurements; they do not prove PCM identity without the recorded master hash/sample count.
Frame differences are visual heuristics and do not establish meaningful continuous motion.
This script does not run strict full-file decode, human listening, human visual review, or target-device playback.
aggregation_method: Separate final-media capture/metrics runs per layout, then verified matching packet hashes; native frames not recaptured.
